# Is your AI coding agent's permission config over-broad?

> Lint Claude Code settings.json or MCP configs for blanket Bash allow rules, plain-http MCP URLs and hardcoded secrets. Free, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
